Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly we need to book flight? But they want estimate total payable amount. We might need to compute cost plus maybe insurance? Not specified. Just cost. So we need to call get_flight_cost. But we need to authenticate first? For get_flight_cost, no access token required. So we can call get_flight_cost directly. But we need to get list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. Also maybe we need to check booking history? But not necessary.

Thus steps: call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost. Then respond.
